items.title: Dave Valentin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe we are filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive in Scottsdale, Arizona. I’m very pleased to have Dave Valentin with me today. [INTERVIEWEE] Pleased to be here.

ctx.x: Dave Valentin was born in the Bronx, New York in 1952. He was playing gigs as a percussionist by the age of 12, later taking up the flute in high school. He appeared on a number of Latin recordings in the late 1970s and was the first artist signed to GRP Records. Dave currently records for Concord and performs with his band both here and abroad.
Dave was interviewed in Scottsdale, Arizona on April 15, 2000, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive.
